freeze.selection: Purposefully varied new hostnames, not a random sample of the web. No candidate target fetched before freeze. No overlap with prior50 hostnames.
freeze.policy: Robots enforced; explicit Cloudflare challenges skipped and retained in denominator disclosure. No automatic replacement.
freeze.checks: Outcome ok + 250 characters + two frozen topical groups. Supplement with labelled source/output spot audits; lexical checks alone do not establish completeness.
freeze.source_edits: None during cohort run. After inspecting initial40 it becomes development data; reserved10 opened after fixes.

initial-first.claim: First exposure only if this cohort has never been run before; reruns are development results.

reserved-first.claim: First exposure only if this cohort has never been run before; reruns are development results.

load-before.claim: Single-host synthetic workload including actual HTTP, parsing, SQLite and fixture server overhead; not public-web throughput.

load-after.claim: Single-host synthetic workload including actual HTTP, parsing, SQLite and fixture server overhead; not public-web throughput.

load-final.claim: Single-host synthetic workload including actual HTTP, parsing, SQLite and fixture server overhead; not public-web throughput.

load-sustained.claim: Single-host synthetic workload including actual HTTP, parsing, SQLite and fixture server overhead; not public-web throughput.

audit.method: Purposeful source/output spot review of 12 initial cases, including both content defects and both strict non-Cloudflare failures. Not a blind human-labelled full-text study. Raw heading counts include navigation and are descriptive, not a pass/fail metric.

cases.review: Opening explanation and table of contents survive, through the final customization section. Formatting is flattened.
Tutorial prose survives, but version navigation, release notice and correction form text remain. Boilerplate precision is imperfect.
Large specification retained through references; 225k characters exceeds the verifier full-text limit. Do not claim full completeness validation.
Initial output lost card titles because nested headers were removed. Fresh post-fix output preserves source card headings. Dates, counts and buttons remain.
Library overview and services survive through the final organizational offices.
Frozen art keyword is absent in source. Short about paragraph and both section labels are extracted; strict benchmark failure retained.
Mission and organizational descriptions survive through ICJ and Nobel Prize sections.
Initial output contained CMS layout/configuration cells. New CMS prose candidate retains narrative sections and removes grid and section metadata; minor navigation/configuration labels remain.
Price stability, banking safety and public-engagement sections are present. Link labels remain.
Mission, vision, activities and license narrative retained.
Core product description and formats are present. Platform links and legal/footer text remain; boilerplate precision is imperfect.
Requested URL returned an actual 404 page. Correctly exported as error; do not substitute a different URL to improve the frozen score.
